resources.string: "1. Import multiple JavaScript source files to use them together.\n"
"2. If multiple scripts register the same source, they are tried in load order until a result is found.\n"
"3. Source switches below each script temporarily enable or disable individual sources until restart.\n"
"4. Playback quality settings apply to all online sources (NetEase, built-in sources, and LX Music scripts).\n"
"5. Use “Show details” to view the author, homepage, and last update.\n"
"6. All imported JavaScript files load automatically at startup."
